newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish thief wearing snake robs stores.
newsitem.headline: Swedish thief wearing snake robs stores.

text.p: A Swede walked into two stores in the southern Swedish town of Kristianstad on Thursday wearing a large snake around his neck and helped himself to goods after terrified staff fled.
"He just took a pair of leather trousers from one shop and a video camera from another and walked off," a spokesman for Kristianstad police said.
"Most women are scared of snakes so he did not even need to say anything."
The spokesman said police were seeking the man, who was in his 30s.
